name: Boman Electric
old_description: Residential, Commercial and Industrial Electrician Services. Serving Hutchinson and Reno County.
about:
Boman Electric operates from Hutchinson, Kansas, serving the Buhler, Hutchinson, and Wichita areas. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but it presents itself as a local electrical contractor offering residential, commercial, and industrial services.

The firm provides full-scope electrical contracting, including new construction wiring, renovations, tenant improvements, service upgrades, and exterior, interior, and landscape lighting. Its technicians handle wiring repair and upgrades, meter and panel service, appliance and lighting installation, and network and telephone installations. The company emphasizes design-to-finish project management, with estimators and project managers coordinating work to meet code requirements.

Customers span residential homeowners, commercial property managers, and industrial facilities across Reno County and the surrounding region. The company cites experience with projects ranging from single-family home rewiring to commercial tenant build-outs and industrial service upgrades.

Boman Electric differentiates itself through rapid, accurate diagnosis of electrical issues and a commitment to using quality materials. The company states that its personnel aim to leave repairs virtually undetectable and offers personalized service at affordable rates, with a focus on completing projects on time and on budget.
